items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: After that, 1954, another idea occurred to me while I was working with Stan Kenton's orchestra touring in the United States.

ctx.x: Tell me how it occured to you and why and when you decided to use more than one conga?

Well, the first time was in 1946 when I came to the United States. That time I was playing the conga and the quinto because the pair of dancers that brought me were supposed to bring a conga player, and a bongo player to accompany their show. But as the budget was weak, they were like, "Well, the one who is playing the rumba in the show is the one we have to take because he is doing the daily work," and that was me. And being that there was no budget, I said, "Okay, I'm going to try something to see if you like…
